workskins.title: Community Workskins
workskins.featuredTitle: Need CSS effects for your fic?
workskins.featuredBody: Effects for AO3 is a free collection of CSS effects and templates for AO3 works - browse the examples, grab the code, and paste it straight into your work skin. Built by a fellow dev who's been generous enough to send readers our way, too.
workskins.comingSoonTitle: Community-submitted workskins are on the way
workskins.comingSoonBody: Want to contribute a workskin? Reach out via the contact form and we'll add it here.
